title: Long tours, California and hits
summary: Road trips ran two to nine months; recording was mostly in Chicago and New York.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How long would the road trips be? How long would you usually be gone?
It varied. Sometimes two months, sometimes three months. The last one was nine months. That's when we went to California.
Was that your first trip to California?
How'd the band go over on the West Coast?
We went over everywhere we played. We went over great.
And, of course, you were recording a lot during that time, too?
Yeah, different -- like, you know, New York, we did most of our recording in Chicago and New York.
Did the band have any hits during that -- I know "Boogie Woogie on St. Louis Blues."
Did they have any in the mid-thirties?
But they were on jukeboxes and --
